results.name: Slim Astronaut – Stylized Space Explorer
results.description:
A sleek and futuristic 3D character of a stylized astronaut, designed with a slim silhouette and minimalist detail. Perfect for sci-fi animations, games, VR adventures, or NFT collectibles. The model blends realism with a cartoon edge, ideal for projects that require a modern yet expressive space hero.

Whether he's landing on a tiny planet, drifting in zero-G, or part of a space station crew — this astronaut is ready to explore the universe!

Model Highlights:

    Clean topology with optimized mesh

    Game/VR ready, riggable for animation

    Stylized proportions for cartoon or cel-shaded projects

    Compatible with looping idle or walking animations

results.name: Steel Soldier
results.description:
The player's avatar from Steel Ascension, a game I helped to make as part of my Masters degree at the University of Bolton.

**Note:** This is a game-ready version of the model that would normally be viewed from a top down perspective, hence the low texture resolution, polygon count, and the fact that the model is hollow from below.
